question: What is the meaning of ease of re-assembly in relation to design for recycling?
description: Ease of re-assembly refers to the simplicity with which building components can be disassembled and reassembled for reuse or recycling. In the context of design for recycling, this concept emphasizes the importance of designing building components in a way that facilitates their separation and reuse, thereby promoting a circular economy and reducing waste.
